title: Document Big Beat tease-and-reveal sample phrasing
description: Capture the reusable Big Beat arranging pattern: repeat a short fixed-pitch opening chop to tease a recognizable sample, then release one complete untransposed phrase. Distinguish it from indiscriminate sparse chopping and continuous looping.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Added a focused Tease, then reveal a recognizable phrase section to write-big-beat-score. It specifies fixed-pitch eighth/quarter micro-chops that resolve to a single complete, untransposed phrase, differentiating the technique from continuous looping and generic sparse chopping. Skill validator passed.
